text: Simvastatin is a competitive inhibitor of HMG-CoA reductase (HMGCR), the rate-limiting enzyme in the mevalonate pathway responsible for cholesterol biosynthesis. By binding to the active site of HMGCR, simvastatin prevents the conversion of HMG-CoA to mevalonate, thereby reducing intracellular cholesterol levels and upregulating LDL receptor expression to lower systemic LDL-cholesterol in patients with dyslipidemia.
